title: Harshang Pattern floral carpet (red ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan
notes: Harshang Pattern floral carpet (red ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul. inv. no 938 (1-691) from the Mosque of Ali Pasha, Tokat, Turkey. 235 x 530 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 87. A lozenge pattern composed of groups of four light and dark blue and yellow vertical and red horizontal palmettes.
